acceptance_scope: The hash-bound design is a coherent proposal for comparing the three existing frozen default signal families across the declared 25-asset scope using the already accepted shared-cash ledger. Acceptance is DESIGN ONLY, not operator adoption of allocation/cost/horizon/statistical choices, a freeze, implementation permission, experiment registration or phase authorization.

assessment.subject: Allocation and strategy identity
assessment.judgment: No blocking contradiction found. S/B/H definitions separate SELL-held and BUY-flat events from ignored repeated actions. An all-HOLD/no-event close emits None, so this is not periodic rebalancing. The new-entry allocation min(1/25,R/len(B)) is bounded by residual cash-plus-selling weight and not silently renormalized over known exclusions. The retained close weights of H can resize non-selling units at the next open; the design explicitly disclaims exact-unit/trade-path parity and requires incidental turnover reporting. The 1/25 number is an entry target, not a post-gap hard exposure limit.
assessment.limit: The allocation is a new UNADOPTED policy, despite frozen signal parameters. There is no implemented or executed bridge proof in this assignment.

assessment.subject: Causal inputs, missingness and 25-asset scope
assessment.judgment: All 25 configured asset labels remain in the consideration denominator, not a certified Coinbase product/tradability set. Exact IDs and dated known/applicable permissions/precision are required, no automatic MATIC/POL or other substitution. Known exclusion leaves cash; required unknowns remain INCOMPLETE. Documented recent-listing insufficiency is distinguished from unexplained gaps. Completed, copied 300-hour OHLCV and availability cutoffs are explicit; the current ledger's open/close-only callback is not falsely represented as an existing OHLCV interface.
assessment.limit: Raw-OHLCV bridge implementation, future-perturbation proof and actual dated coverage remain future preflight requirements, not blockers to reviewing this proposal as a design.

assessment.subject: Incumbent semantics
assessment.judgment: The proposed BTC/ETH source target formula agrees with target(): positive 28-day close return, half-account times min(1,0.50/annualized volatility) per asset. The source VOL expression is 30 daily returns with population standard deviation and sqrt(365); the source weekday rule refers to the daily candle whose start is Sunday. The design preserves that Sunday-close decision profile and excludes bands/retuning. A 61-complete-day warm-up is sufficient to supply the referenced lookbacks. No return-path or old-cost parity is claimed: this is a future same-engine extension with declared new costs, not a rerun of the old study.
assessment.limit: Synthetic UTC-day/window/weekly timing parity still must prove the bridge, including the Sunday candle ending at Monday activation A. The executable study was read as text only, never imported or run.

assessment.subject: Comparable capital, controls and prospective clock
assessment.judgment: Equal declared before-fill C=1000, common costs and one account per alternative avoid summing independent wallets. Benchmark entries at A pay actual modelled entry costs without NAV rebasing. A failed intended benchmark entry invalidates the relevant comparison rather than relabeling cash as hold. Fixed-unit 25/25/50 is distinct from weekly constant-weight rebalancing. Primary marked NAV and optional synthetic close liquidation remain separate, with the accepted ledger's corrected execution-price provenance and residual/dust handling retained.
assessment.clock: 182 days equals 4368 hours and two 91-day halves. The first completed decision hour ends at A; first execution at A belongs to the evaluation. At B only final close marking is included, not pending next-open execution. Midpoint state/preceding-close anchor carry and deferred half-period reporting prevent split resets or interim winner selection.
assessment.limit: A requires a future signed freeze and preflight; missed activation is not silently shifted. None exists or is authorized by this review.

assessment.classification: SHOWN declared economic screen; empirical economics UNVERIFIED
assessment.subject: Costs, overhead and return-screen meaning
assessment.judgment: Both fee scenarios and the 25bps adverse adjustment are explicitly assumptions rather than certified execution costs. No extra spread is double-charged. The separate 20 USD/month overhead scenario is not deducted from the wallet or summed across 14 hypothetical alternatives. Its 182-day amount is exactly 43680/365 USD, approximately 119.67 USD; positive after-overhead profit requires clearing this hurdle after modelled trading costs. Equal common overhead cancels in pairwise same-period wealth advantage; it must not be subtracted twice from that contrast.
assessment.screen: The primary gate requires complete data, positive after-overhead primary profit, superiority to BTC hold and incumbent, the proposed adjusted inference result and higher-fee robustness. Thirty closed cycles are explicitly not thirty independent observations. Missing data is not a negative economic verdict; drawdown/risk approval is not manufactured by a return screen.
assessment.limit: No evidence here establishes positive returns, power, capacity, fee applicability or a tolerable loss profile. No 182-day annualization into expected income is approved.

assessment.classification: SHOWN internal specification arithmetic; method validity UNVERIFIED
assessment.subject: Proposed inference and multiplicity
assessment.judgment: Three prespecified family-minus-incumbent contrasts at one primary cost scenario align with a 0.05/3 one-sided tail. The specified empirical 1/60 inverted-CDF quantile has one-based order rank 334 for 20000 replicates. Joint all-arm calendar-block resampling preserves the proposed cross-arm pairing; recompounding simple-return rows from original C keeps entry costs in first-day returns without a post-fill baseline reset. This is explicitly portfolio-return resampling, not a regenerated executable trade path. Fixed primary seven-day blocks and report-only 14/28 sensitivities do not authorize outcome-selected methods.
assessment.limit: This is not a certification of nominal coverage, familywise error control, stationarity, sample power or bootstrap reliability. The design correctly requires null/known-effect/dependence/pairing/recomposition fixtures and independent method review before freeze and forbids an inferential PASS if that proof fails. Approximate percentile screening must retain that qualification.

assessment.subject: Selection accounting and authority
assessment.judgment: Three proposed policies, 75 symbol-family considerations, 150 symbol-family-cost considerations and 14 alternative trajectories are arithmetically consistent and explicitly not an effective independent N. No per-symbol winner selection, rescue of prior FAILs, family blending, DSR claim or fresh-holdout relabeling is authorized. The historical candidate allocation contract and corrected ledger acceptance are reused without reopening their review cycles.

outstanding_boundaries.subject: Operator adoption
outstanding_boundaries.detail: Capital, venue/product mapping, allocation, cost scenarios, horizon, economic screen and statistical method remain unadopted draft choices. This review does not choose them for the operator.

outstanding_boundaries.subject: Synthetic bridge proof
outstanding_boundaries.detail: Future bounded OHLCV/event-allocation/incumbent interface implementation and its stated causal/timing/missingness/continuity fixtures require separate authorization and review. Accepted ledger proof alone does not cover this missing bridge.

outstanding_boundaries.subject: Inference validation
outstanding_boundaries.detail: The proposed bootstrap needs synthetic calibration and independent method review before any statistical freeze; no external-paper or empirical calibration claim was made or validated here.

outstanding_boundaries.subject: Activation/data preflight
outstanding_boundaries.detail: Exact product identities, dated permissions/precision and future complete-path availability must be evidenced before an authorized activation. No collector or live feasibility work is initiated by this design acceptance.

retained_limitations: Acceptance is coherence/source-identity review of a proposal, not adoption, freeze, implementation permission, preregistration or authority for a next phase.
One Coinbase USD spot venue with no FX/cash yield, and modelled full fills with assumed adverse price adjustment/dated eligibility, remain the two explicit modelling assumptions.
The OHLCV bridge is absent and the existing shared ledger callback has only open/close history; this unsupported interface is disclosed rather than certified.
The incumbent formula was compared as source text. UTC aggregation and exact boundary execution still need future synthetic parity, not an old market-study rerun.
Twenty-five configured names do not prove 25 eligible Coinbase products or account/geographic entitlement. Known exclusion and unknown/incomplete status must remain distinct.
No external model, runtime restoration, SDK, whole-repository audit, historical market evaluation or prior verdict was reopened.
Positive bootstrap lower bounds would remain approximate, conditional modelled screens, not a guaranteed confidence statement, profitability probability or promotion gate.
General risk tolerance, liquidity/partial fills, execution capacity, empirical fee/spread calibration and economic benefit remain unverified.
